basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer building TypeScript and React features for enterprise platforms, backed by relational databases, Kafka pipelines, and well-designed APIs.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on enterprise financial platforms, leading feature delivery and cross-functional collaboration across international teams.
highlights: Developed full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating with internal enterprise systems.
Optimized Oracle SQL schemas, stored procedures, JPA/Hibernate mappings, and high-throughput Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Led end-to-end delivery of production features and integrations, from requirements and API design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.
Built automated health-check tooling and validation scripts to detect and remediate deployment regressions, improving operational stability for supported solutions.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Built security tooling for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Built a React/Redux security dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in security risk-scoring algorithms, improving data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Developed full-stack automation solutions to streamline enterprise business processes.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation solutions using C#/.NET and SQL to streamline enterprise workflows across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments.

projects.name: Meal Planner
projects.description: Full-stack household meal-planning application that turns shared weekly decisions into an actionable grocery workflow.
highlights: Delivered a multi-user SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Convex application with authentication, household onboarding, shared planning, real-time data, and edge-case handling
Defined and delivered a focused product experience spanning meal management, weekly planning, household collaboration, leftover tracking, and synchronized shopping lists

projects.name: to-bot
projects.description: Discord bot that automates tournament organizer workflows, including start.gg account verification and self-service tournament management.
highlights: Built a TypeScript Discord bot that verifies start.gg accounts and lets users view entered tournaments and self-DQ through direct messages
Persisted verification and tournament state in SQLite, running as a pure-DM bot with no guild server or privileged intents
